articles.summary: Three bridges in Kyiv were hit in a Russian ballistic missile attack, officials in the Ukrainian capital said, after President Vladimir Putin vowed revenge.

articles.title: On-the-run female chemistry teacher arrested 70 miles away in Hampshire after dodging sentence for having sex with 14-year-old pupil up to 30 times
articles.summary: Police are hunting female chemistry teacher Sally-Anne Bowen who slept with a 14-year-old pupil up to 30 times and seduced another after she failed to turn up to court to be sentenced.

articles.title: USDA boss Brooke Rollins barred from sending Christian messages to federal workers
articles.summary: Rollins, a Texas native and devout Christian, has repeatedly used USDA communications to promote her religious beliefs, including in messages marking Christmas, Easter and Thanksgiving.

articles.title: Agriculture Secretary’s Christian Messages to Staff Went ‘Too Far,’ Judge Says
articles.summary: A federal judge ordered limits on Brooke Rollins’s promotion of her religious beliefs, saying her emails to her department had violated the First Amendment.

articles.title: Hakeem Jeffries wins overwhelming Speaker-designate vote as progressives' revolt falls flat
articles.summary: House Democrats unified behind Hakeem Jeffries with 251 of 262 secret ballots as 11 progressive holdouts demanded votes on ICE, Gaza and Citizens United.

articles.title: Hakeem Jeffries’ progressive defectors reveal the limits of their power: From the Politics Desk
articles.summary: Seven incoming members of the House Democratic Caucus made their first big move since winning their elections this month, publicly stating that they voted against Hakeem Jeffries’ nomination to be the next speaker after a secret-ballot contest today.
